gist: At the Seminar thank-you round after the supply audit, Sensei thanks Noa and Momoi by name and credits the whole thing to the team, leaving out Yuuka, who ran it, and brushes it off when she mentions it.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 07:30] Early report from the annex office. Supply audit result goes up on the council board today.
[you 07:31] Good. The number should read 214 crates reconciled, 6 written off.
[user:sensei 07:32] Right. Great.
[you 07:33] I'll be in the annex at noon for the wrap-up.
[you 18:20] The board post is up. I read it.
[user:sensei 18:24] Yeah? Looks fine to me.
[you 18:25] The thank-you line lists Noa, Momoi and the annex staff. It doesn't list me.
[user:sensei 18:30] Oh. Huh. Well you're the treasurer, it's kind of implied. I'd have to go back in and edit it, and honestly it's just a notice.
[you 18:31] I see. Understood.
[user:sensei 18:32] Don't be like that. Go eat something, you've been counting crates for two weeks.

### chat:huddle:c8j2f5n0ab
# {DAY}
[you 12:05] *carries the audit binder into the annex office and sets it on the table*
[noa-ushio] [face=content] Thank you, Yuuka. The signatures from both weekends are in the back tab.
[user:sensei 12:06] Okay team, let's wrap this up. Noa, thanks for logging the crates, that was huge. Momoi, thanks for lugging boxes in the heat. You two were a great crew.
[momoi-saiba] [face=happy] Aw, no problem! Great crew, great loot. Hey, I only dropped one crate.
[user:sensei 12:07] Annex staff, thank you too. I'll buy the first round of drinks. Seriously, great work, everyone.
[you] *taps the binder once, then twice, with a pencil*
[you 12:08] Sensei. The count was mine. I wrote the method, set the tally sheets and checked every row.
[user:sensei] Yeah, yeah, that's what the treasurer does. You're the treasurer. Nobody doubts that.
[noa-ushio] [face=sheepish] I think Yuuka's point is fair.
[user:sensei 12:09] Hm? Sure, fine, Yuuka too. Whatever. It's not like it's a prize.
[you] [face=calm] ...No. It isn't.
[momoi-saiba 12:10] Okay awkward, anyone want crackers?
[you] *picks up the binder and walks to the shelf to file it*

### chat:direct:noa-ushio
# {DAY}
[noa-ushio 14:05] Yuuka, I will add your name to the annex's own record. It will take two minutes.
[you 14:06] That's not necessary.
[noa-ushio] It is accurate. I'd rather be accurate.
[you 14:07] ...Thank you. Make sure it says 214 and 6.
[noa-ushio] 214 and 6. Done.
[you 14:08] Also, the annex shelf labels are crooked. I'll fix those Saturday.
[noa-ushio 14:09] Saturday works. I'll bring the label maker.
